description: Set your social username, interests, and feed sizes. Writes to the chain: this prepares an unsigned transaction (an intent) for `signer`; nothing happens until you sign it with geode-local-signer and submit it with geode_submit_intent.

max_messages_in_my_feed.description: Non-negative integer as a string of digits

max_messages_in_my_paid_feed.description: Non-negative integer as a string of digits

my_interests.description: UTF-8 text, at most 512 bytes; no control or invisible characters

my_username.description: UTF-8 text, at most 512 bytes; no control or invisible characters

signer.description: Your account address (SS58). The transaction is prepared for this account; you sign it on your own machine with geode-local-signer.

name: geode_social_update_settings
title: Social: update settings
